notes: Official names, descriptions and grades as listed by Push Square and cross-checked against GameMapa (GamesRadar+ / PowerPyx). 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation; 0 online trophies; one playthrough is enough. Difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours to Platinum (PowerPyx, via GameMapa). Only one trophy is possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap (pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
GameMapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies: Full List, Gamerscore and Platinum Roadmap (gamemapa.com/en/gta-6/guides/gta-6-trophy-achievement-list/)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (via GameMapa)
GamesRadar+ — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list (via GameMapa)
PSNProfiles / TrueTrophies — trophy counts and hidden flags (via sixshore.com/gta-6/guides/trophies-and-achievements/)

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order (story, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks cleanup) and this is the last trophy you earn. One playthrough is enough and every trophy is single-player, so no online grind stands between you and it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this unlocks naturally within your first hour: follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing introduction and finish the mission. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through Chapter 1's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. While you are in Chapter 1, do the one possibly-missable thing in the game: after an early mission Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house and steps out to the balcony — follow her and accept the prompt (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every Chapter 2 mission and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Side activities you meet along the way (fishing with Cal, early stranger icons) already count toward later trophies, so take them as they appear rather than rushing past.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3's missions. By now the map has opened up: start scanning new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel (100% completion needs 200 of 277 vehicle models) and study animals through binoculars (100 of 255) — both are tracked in the Progress menu.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault robberies open through an optional mission in this chapter — there are 8 vaults and 100% completion needs all of them, so start them now rather than leaving the whole set for post-game cleanup.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission of the campaign. Once it pops, free roam stays open and the 100% Completion Checklist appears under Progress > Stats — that checklist is the spine of the rest of the Platinum run, so open it before you start mopping up.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission; complete it and the trophy unlocks. It cannot be missed — keep playing the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission; finish it to unlock this. Robbing a bank vault during heist-style missions gives you a 4-star wanted level, which is also how Hot Together tends to pop on its own.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission; complete it. Nothing special to prepare — story progress alone unlocks it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission; finish it and this unlocks. Keep a separate manual save at the start and end of every chapter (15 manual slots) — with no mission replay, those saves are your safety net for anything you want to redo.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story mission at Vice City International Airport; complete it. Remember the airport layout — you will come back here for Catch Me if You Can, stealing an airliner from terminals E3/E4.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission; complete it. It is the last of the 12 story trophies, so by the time it pops you are close to the finale and the post-game checklist.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the backbone of the Platinum. After the story, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry listing everything it counts. PowerPyx notes the list is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles count only partly, but you do need every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of the 80 Challenges and 15 of the 18 card sets. Work the checklist top to bottom after the ending; most other trophies pop along the way. Budget about 100 hours for this phase.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in Leonida — 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — and you need any 250. Stunt Jumps off ramps and bridges are the easiest bulk source; use the map (Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots) and your Progress > Activities > Stunts tracker to pick off the ones near you as you travel. 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past this trophy if you want the Platinum.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Most pop naturally during the story and early free roam; the easiest deliberate ones are a round of golf, a game of pool, and one arcade game (which also earns Stick Fiddler). Check Progress > Activities if you are unsure which type you still need.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Two range locations anchor the activity: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; find them on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some unlock only after you meet other conditions shown on the map. Take your time and learn each challenge's scoring before burning attempts; steady aim beats fast trigger work.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find them on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones. Drone races are also required for 100% completion, so a win at every spot serves the Platinum twice over.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count. There are 40 race locations in total; track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating matters (upgrade it at Mod Shops). Pick races that suit the car you have rather than forcing one vehicle everywhere.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal's questline starts in Chapter 1: he asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area on your map until you land one of suitable size — you need a boat with a fishing rod, but plenty sit around the area to borrow. Catching the fish and beating Cal's challenge pops the trophy; the fishing itself also counts toward the fishing activity for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are 4 video games to choose from and three of them sit on the TV at home, so this is one of the cheapest trophies in the list — sit down at home, finish a game, and it pops. It also ticks the video-game activity for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's missions; the trophy pops on the final one. Andy's 5 quests are Lucia-only and start from Chapter 3 — play as Lucia when the purple stranger icons appear and work through his chain in order. Every side character tied to a trophy is still around in free roam after the ending, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's chain; the final mission is Maritime Disputes and this pops when it ends. Kenton's quests revolve around clearing 7 shipwrecks and start from Chapter 1, so you can chip away at them across the whole game. Kenton goes quiet for a while mid-game — that is normal; he comes back.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's chain; the final mission is Hometown Heroes. Billy's 5 quests run out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub and start from Chapter 2. Do them as they appear — stranger questlines are the usual leftover after the 100% checklist, so clearing Billy early saves cleanup time.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks questlines. Only some side questlines count, and which ones is still being confirmed — the safe play is to finish every stranger strand you find (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest), since the five side-character finals above already cover five of the eight. Purple icons and black icons with pink letters mark them on the map; all of it can be done after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's chain is a delivery list: deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List, starting from Chapter 3. Use the Wish List vehicle locations to hunt each car down — stolen cars in the right model count, so keep an eye out while driving around Leonida rather than making 16 special trips. The final delivery pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's chain: destroy the labs (the Kitty Litter Lab locations help) and complete his last quest. Tyrone's missions are Jason-only and start from Chapter 3, so switch to Jason when his icons appear. Like the other side characters, Tyrone is still available in free roam after the ending.
trophies.name: Spin on This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots. A meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played. THE ONE POSSIBLY-MISSABLE TROPHY: after an early Chapter 1 mission, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house and heads to the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt, and the Progress counter goes up by 1, yet the balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others. PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, and you cannot do it again after Chapter 1 — so just do it. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; discovered spots also show on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret; the quest is Jason-only. The exact animal is still being confirmed, so follow Bret's quest prompts in game — the target will be named when the hunt begins. Studying animals through binoculars also feeds the 100% checklist (100 of 255 animals), so keep the binoculars handy whenever you are out hunting.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward progress. Track sets at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. 100% completion needs 15 sets, so this trophy pops on the way — do not stop at 3 if you are chasing the Platinum.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app on Jason's or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open it). Anything scannable counts: 31 WAiNK Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher Tags. Make scanning a habit every time you reach a new place — it also discovers vehicles for Whip It Good. Check progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game Challenges — skill-based feats listed under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges. 100% completion needs 70, so aim past 50 and skip the nastiest ones: only 70 of 80 are required, which leaves room to dodge the challenges you hate most. Pick the ones that match how you already play and let the rest come naturally.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the heat entirely. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and the trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone. It often unlocks by itself, since robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well. Note the trophy is delayed — it pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if nothing happens at once. Keep moving between shops and do not let the heat fade.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting inside one or scanning it with WAiNK counts. This should happen naturally across the story, but scanning every new vehicle you pass speeds it up a lot. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops. Check what you have found at Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — pick gang members at their illegal operations, where targets are plentiful and the game counts them.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner at Vice City International Airport and fly away. The easiest airliner is docked at terminals E3/E4; get aboard, take off, and the trophy unlocks once you are 1 km away from the airport. Expect immediate heat — climb fast, put distance between you and the runways, and do not bother fighting back.
trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station. Getting in is the hard part — the base is guarded and the alarm goes up fast — so plan your approach, grab the tank, and drive it clear of the base. Once you are rolling in the Rhino, the trophy is yours; surviving the getaway is optional.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which arrives in Chapter 3, so this cannot be done earlier. Plan the hit quietly: case the store, use the Snap Gun where it helps, take what you need and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A clean run pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape with the take. There are 8 vaults in total and 100% completion needs all of them, so treat this as the halfway mark, not the finish. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. Each vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level, which is also why Hot Together often pops during these jobs — plan your escape route before you crack the vault.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and get away before the response arrives. A fast getaway car parked nearby matters more than firepower: the robbery itself is quick, the escape is the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner — the map fills in as you travel, and the trophy pops when the last patch of fog is gone. Pair this with stunt runs, WAiNK scans and vehicle discovery: one long road trip across the state knocks out progress on all four at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist across Leonida, so you have plenty of choice. Hit the operations as you find them during free roam; each gang's turf is marked well enough once you start looking. This is also prime territory for Gunslinger, since gang members at illegal operations are the targets that count.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown — so the practical advice is to visit Ocean Beach's bars and waterfront spots and try the cocktail options on offer. Check back as the community pins the trigger down; the description itself is the best clue available.
trophies.name: In the Beginning...

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a car showroom. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, but the description points at a classic-style showroom smash-out — pick a vehicle showroom, get a car moving inside it, and drive straight out through the glass. Treat it as an experiment: if it does not pop, try another showroom or another approach and watch for community confirmations.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn. GameMapa's read of this one: take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling and lose the police. Go in, grab the valuables, and break contact — a clean getaway matters as much as the grab. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so treat the valuables-plus-escape as the working method.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles. Keep both characters' Strength topped up in parallel rather than maxing one and starting the other from zero — it halves the grind.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. This is a volume trophy: every choice that moves your profile counts, and 500 of them across a full playthrough adds up on its own. Play normally, make decisions rather than standing still, and check the Criminal Profile in the Progress menu to watch the count climb. The one profile to avoid is Irredeemable — it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt at something — the exact trigger is still unconfirmed and PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. The working read is that it involves retrying a failed attempt at an activity or event and succeeding the second time. Keep it on your radar as the community solves it; do not grind blindly for it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description hints at something strange — the exact trigger is still unconfirmed. This is one of the five hidden trophies PowerPyx lists as unsolved, so the honest guide is: watch for community findings, and when something weird happens in Leonida, pay attention — the strangest moments in the game are the likeliest triggers for this one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so the practical method is a drive-by melee hit on a target at speed. Try it on open roads with a clear run-up, and keep an eye on community confirmations for the precise setup.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; fences convert them into clean cash over time. The total is cumulative, so keep feeding bills to fences whenever you have them — by the late game, with vaults and truck robberies behind you, the quarter-million arrives on its own. A few fences disappear for good during the story, so do not leave all your laundering until after the ending.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across any shops — the total is cumulative and any spending counts. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style. The easiest route is to let it happen naturally (cars, upgrades, clothes, ammo) and then top it up with a deliberate shopping run once you are close. Buying the 8 garages for Little Boxes ($160,000) also pushes this total along.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages from the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800) — $160,000 in total. Each garage adds a parking spot, and registered vehicles can be called anywhere with Scooter Bros. Buy them as you can afford them; the total also feeds Treat Yo Self.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have an empty parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Buy more garages from the Vice City Real Estate app if you run out of spots. Scooter Bros then delivers your repaired vehicles to your location for a small fee, so the 10 registrations keep paying off after the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
